statement: This MCP server is draft-only. No tool can send mail, permanently delete mail, report spam, or change account settings. Agent output stops at a Gmail draft or a reviewable outbox item; a human in Zero performs any send.

tools.name: getServerCapabilities
tools.description: Report this MCP server health and capabilities as JSON: name/version, that it is draft-only, the registered tools, and the hard guarantees that no tool can send mail, permanently delete mail, report spam, or change account settings. Read-only; stores nothing.

tools.name: getConnections
tools.description: List the email accounts (connections) linked to the authenticated user — email address and provider only. Read-only.

tools.name: getActiveConnection
tools.description: Return the account currently selected for subsequent tools (email and provider). Read-only.

tools.name: setActiveConnection
tools.description: Select which already-connected account subsequent tools act on, by email address. Changes only the in-session active-account selection; it does NOT modify any account setting and never sends mail. Unknown or other-user addresses are rejected without revealing existence.

email.description: Email address of an already-connected account to select

tools.name: listThreads
tools.description: List email threads as COMPACT metadata only: subject, thread id, latest date, sender, unread flag and label names. Never returns message bodies or attachments. Read-only.

labelIds.description: Restrict to threads carrying these labels

pageToken.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page

tools.name: searchThreads
tools.description: Search email threads and return COMPACT metadata only (subject, id, date, sender, unread, labels). Never returns message bodies or attachments. Read-only.

pageToken.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page

query.description: Search text; matched against stored thread metadata

tools.name: getThread
tools.description: Fetch one thread by id on demand: subject, latest date, sender, and the sanitized text of the latest message (hidden and remote content stripped). Read-only.

threadId.description: Thread id to fetch on demand

tools.name: getThreadSummary
tools.description: Return a short AI summary plus subject/sender/date for one thread. Read-only; stores nothing.

tools.name: getUserLabels
tools.description: List all labels available to the user (name, id, color). Read-only.

tools.name: getLabel
tools.description: Get one label by id (name and id). Read-only.

tools.name: getCurrentDate
tools.description: Return the current server date and time. Read-only.

tools.name: composeEmail
tools.description: Draft an email body with AI assistance and RETURN it to you as text. It only returns text: it does not create a draft, store anything, or send mail.

prompt.description: Instruction or rough draft for the email body

tools.name: listOutbox
tools.description: List the authenticated user outbox draft jobs (id, status, subject, thread, timestamps), optionally filtered by status. Read-only.

tools.name: getOutboxItem
tools.description: Inspect one outbox draft job the user owns, by id. Ids that are missing or owned by another user return an identical not-found result without revealing which. Read-only.

id.description: Outbox item id owned by the authenticated user

tools.name: createDraft
tools.description: Create a Gmail draft stored in the user Gmail Drafts folder for later human review. Stores the given recipients, subject and body as an UNSENT draft. This NEVER sends the email — sending is a separate human action in Zero. Pass a stable idempotencyKey so retries return the same draft instead of creating duplicates.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key: repeat calls return the same draft instead of duplicating it

tools.name: enqueueDraftJob
tools.description: Store a reviewable draft job in the outbox with status "queued". The job holds the given mission/subject/body; a background step later turns it into a Gmail draft that a human must approve in Zero before anything is sent. This NEVER sends mail. Duplicate calls with identical fields return the same outbox item (idempotent).

mission.description: What the reviewable draft should accomplish

tools.name: cancelOutboxItem
tools.description: Cancel an outbox draft job the user owns while it is still queued, generating, draft_ready or approved. Idempotent: cancelling an already-cancelled item reports it as such. Never sends mail. Other-user or missing ids return not-found without revealing existence.

tools.name: retryOutboxItem
tools.description: Re-queue a FAILED outbox draft job the user owns for another generation attempt. Idempotent: retrying an item already back in the queue reports it as such. Never sends mail; sending still requires human approval. Other-user or missing ids return not-found.

id.description: Failed outbox item id to re-queue (idempotent)
